marks.gloss_en: והתנן פטור!
לא קשיא: הא דבעי זיוני, הא דלא בעי זיוני
stam: this [the mishna] is where they require crowns
הא למה זה דומה? לאורג צלצול קטן -- the hem measure is grounded in the likeness to weaving a small belt
the baraita: one who weaves three threads at the beginning is liable
הא למה זה דומה -- לאורג צלצול קטן -- the same grounding in the other baraita
the other baraita: one who weaves two threads onto the gas and onto the imra is liable
והאנן תנן: שלש! -- but we learned 'three' (R' Eliezer's clause of the mishna)
לא קשיא: הא באלימי, הא בקטיני -- this with thick threads, that with thin; which is which is given in two versions (p_v1_*, p_v2_*)
when R' Yitzchak came, he taught: 'two' [in place of the mishna's three]
the mishna, R' Eliezer: one who weaves three threads at the beginning is liable
'Anochi' is a notarikon: 'I Myself wrote [and] gave'
the school of R' Natan: 'for the way is yarat before me' (Num 22:32) -- [the she-ass] feared, saw, turned aside
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: 'what shall we speak and how nitztadak' (Gen 44:16) -- we are upright, righteous, pure, innocent, holy
היכי משכחת לה? -- where do you find [tearing in order to sew]? (a realisability question; kind svara under protest)
the mishna: one who tears in order to sew two stitches [is liable]; the measure is two stitches
what is 'in the nirayim'? Abaye: two in the bat-nira and one in the nira
שנאמר כי אב המון גוים נתתיך -- אב, בחור, חביב, מלך, ותיק, נאמן: the verse's own words are a notarikon
one who wrote one letter as a notarikon: R' Yehoshua ben Beteira obligates [a sin-offering]
רבן גמליאל סבר אין ידיעה לחצי שיעור -- the ground the Gemara gives for his liability
ורבנן סברי יש ידיעה לחצי שיעור -- the ground the Gemara gives for their exemption
Rabban Gamliel holds: there is no awareness for half a measure
one who writes two letters in two lapses of awareness, one in the morning and one at dusk: Rabban Gamliel obligates [a sin-offering]
